m. (-कः)
The name of an inspired legislator older than MANU.

m. (-कः)
1 A butcher, a poulterer, a vender of the flesh of beasts or birds.
2 Chase, hunting.
E.
शूना a slaughterhouse, ठञ् aff.

m. (-कः)
A vender of the flesh of beasts or birds.
E.
सून a place of slaughter, ठक् aff.

mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
Belonging or relating to a slaughter-house, &c.
n. (-नं)
Butcher's meat.
E.
सूना, and अण् aff.

m. (-न्दी)
BALARĀMA the brother of KṚṢṆA.
E.
सौनन्द his club, इनि aff.

n. (-र्य्यं)
Beauty, loveliness.
E.
सुन्दर handsome, ष्यञ् aff.
